# Host-defect fixes: offscreen evidence

Offscreen Qt render of the real `Bar` for the Cockpit, Cockpit Clear and Hornero Left presets at 1920x1080, Night and Day, over a stand-in pink/purple gradient (no wallpaper, no host capture). The harness shims the layer-shell windows, so popouts, wallpaper sampling for Cockpit Clear ink and the frame are not drawn. Cockpit Clear shows no slab by design.
